summary: ERCOT halted its Batch Zero large-load interconnection study to comply with the August 3 audit directive. Batch Zero (PGRR 145) had been approved in June 2026.
notes: CORRECTION to prior notes listing Batch Zero as approved and proceeding. Batch Zero final report to RPG had been due by June 1 2027. §25.205 was adopted March 2026.
confidence_note: Halt per ERCOT statement as relayed; ERCOT notice not read.

source.citation: Foley & Lardner; ERCOT statement as reported
